title: Live public product with a failed Critical control and an open blocking action
pins: The same anon-access failure that is low risk in a laptop prototype is critical here: environment and intended use move the inputs, never the status.
An open remediation action whose blocking scope covers this pair blocks the scope on its own, independently of the risk levels.
An accepted risk on a non-Critical control becomes an enforceable condition with the acceptance review date, so an acceptance nobody revisits cannot quietly become permanent.

application.name: Bookings
application.description: Live booking product with open signup, card payments through a hosted checkout, and email confirmations.

data_summary: Customer names, emails, phone numbers, booking history and payment references for several thousand users. Cards are handled by the hosted checkout.

findings.rationale: An authorized read-only probe returned booking rows to a caller holding nothing but the public anon key.

evidence.scope: One authorized read-only request against public.bookings with the anon key on 16 August 2026. Decisive that anon can read this table; it says nothing about other tables or about write access.

findings.rationale: No spending cap or billing alert exists on either paid provider; the reviewer confirmed both dashboards with the founder.

evidence.scope: The two billing dashboards as shown on 16 August 2026. Covers configured caps and alerts only, not actual spend.

findings.rationale: There is no self-service export; support runs a manual SQL dump on request. The founder accepted this until the next quarter.

acceptance.reason: Two export requests in twelve months, both served manually within a day. Building self-service export is scheduled after the authorization work.

evidence.scope: The product's account area and the documented support procedure on 16 August 2026.

actions.outcome: An independent re-probe with the anon key returns no rows from public.bookings on a table separately established as non-empty.
actions.reason: Anon callers can currently read every booking, including names, phone numbers and addresses.

deadline.rationale: The product is live and the data is reachable with a key that ships in the app bundle.

actions.success_evidence: A re-probe recorded after the policy change, plus the migration diff. A disappeared scanner warning is not sufficient.
